subject: Merchant onboarding: bank credentials & remittance mapping
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@meridianlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@meridianlabs.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Merchant bank proof + remittance sample for PO mapping

Hi Marissa / Priyom,

Thanks for the quick onboarding touchpoint earlier. Attached are the documents your team asked for so we can finish finance onboarding:

- bank_letter_redacted.pdf (bank confirmation letter, account ending in 4321)
- remit_sample.csv (sample remittance CSV from our AP system)

A couple of notes from our side:
- We currently use a single bank account for payables; we can provide a virtual-account style remitter reference if needed, but it will be a fixed prefix: MERID-<PO#>.
- Our AP team exports the remittance file with fields: invoice_id, invoice_date, po_number, remit_reference. See remit_sample.csv.

What we need from Redwood to finalize:
1) Confirmation that the bank letter format is acceptable for your vendor verification (redacted account numbers OK).
2) Guidance on PO->remit mapping you prefer (do you want PO number as the top-level remitter or a concatenated field?).
3) Any required tax forms or an upload link for the vendor portal.

If useful I can schedule a short call with our AP lead next week.

Thanks,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Finance, Meridian Labs
sofia@meridianlabs.com
[Attachment: bank_letter_redacted.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: remit_sample.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@meridianlabs.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Merchant bank proof + remittance sample for PO mapping

Hi Sofia,

Appreciate the materials — bank letter and sample CSV came through fine. A couple quick asks so we can complete vendor activation:

- Can you also send a completed W-9 (or equivalent tax form) for Meridian Labs? We need this on file before first pay run.
- I'll kick off the vendor portal invite (one of our onboarding steps). Please look for an email from vendor-portal@redwood.com and complete the banking page there.
- I attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf which outlines the pieces we collect and the expected order for activation.

On the remittance mapping: if Meridian can expose the invoice_id and po_number fields separately, that works best for our downstream PO matching. If you must consolidate, the preferred concatenation is PO:<po_number>|INV:<invoice_id>.

Jonas — tagging you for any compliance flags on the redacted bank doc (I think redacted acct is fine but please confirm).

Sofia — once you upload the W-9 and accept the portal invite, we can schedule the micro-deposit test. Typical turnaround is 2 business days after upload.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@meridianlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Merchant bank proof + remittance sample for PO mapping

Hi Sofia — thanks for sending these. Quick internal confirmation: 

- The redacted bank letter is acceptable for our vendor verification checklist. Jonas — no objections?
- For production payments we prefer a short micro-deposit verification (two small deposits) so finance can validate the account before the first ACH. Marissa will schedule that after the portal upload.
- On remittance mapping: Redwood's AP system ingests separate PO and invoice fields and will link on po_number then invoice_id. If Meridian can keep those as discrete columns, that eliminates manual reconciliation. If you must concatenate, please use the PO:<po_number>|INV:<invoice_id> format Marissa suggested — we'll parse that reliably.

To help, I attached a remittance_mapping_example.csv (two rows) showing how we prefer fields mapped. If Meridian's ERP can export an SFTP-delivered CSV on pay date that includes the remit_reference column, that also works.

Action items for Meridian:
- Upload W-9 to portal.
- Confirm whether you prefer virtual-account remitter prefix (MERID-) or standard remitter free-text.
- Complete the ACH DocuSign authorization (link below in Marissa's follow-up) so we can schedule micro-deposits.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
FinOps, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
[Attachment: remittance_mapping_example.csv (csv)]

Subject: Re: Merchant bank proof + remittance sample for PO mapping

Marissa / Priyom — thanks, good to hear. Per your checklist: attached is our W-9 (W9_Meridian.pdf).

We can export discrete columns (invoice_id, po_number) starting with the next pay cycle — we'll also add the optional remit_reference column if helpful. We prefer to use the virtual-account prefix MERID- for internal routing, but if Redwood prefers free-text remit_reference we can toggle.

We have completed the ACH authorization via DocuSign; envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d-ACH-AUTH. Please confirm when micro-deposits are initiated so our AP team can watch for the two small amounts and confirm.

Attachments: W9_Meridian.pdf

If convenient, I can put our AP manager on a 20-minute sync tomorrow afternoon to confirm SFTP parameters and verify the sample CSV layout matches your remittance_mapping_example.csv.

Thanks,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Finance, Meridian Labs
sofia@meridianlabs.com
[Attachment: W9_Meridian.pdf (pdf)]
